name: v_cloudflare_errors
comment: Cloudflare Worker 5xx responses, non-ok outcomes, error logs, and uncaught exceptions
statement:
FROM scopedb.public.cloudflare_worker_events
WHERE level = 'error'
   OR outcome != 'ok'
   OR (status IS NOT NULL AND status >= 500)
SELECT
    occurred_at,
    service,
    event_type,
    outcome,
    level,
    method,
    host,
    path,
    status,
    ray_id,
    message,
    attributes['invocation_id']::string AS invocation_id,
    attributes['exception_name']::string AS exception_name,
    attributes['stack']::string AS stack,
    attributes
